source_caption:
🎬 Rule Breakers (2025)

Rule Breakers follows Roya Mahboob, a courageous Afghan technology entrepreneur who challenges the restrictions placed on girls and women in Afghanistan by creating opportunities for young female students to pursue education in science, technology, and robotics. Determined to prove that talent and ambition should never be limited by gender, Roya helps establish an all-girls robotics team, bringing together a group of intelligent and passionate teenagers who dream of competing on the international stage. Despite facing enormous cultural pressure, financial difficulties, security threats, and resistance from those who oppose girls receiving an education, the team refuses to abandon its ambitions. As the students work tirelessly to design and build their robots, they develop close friendships, overcome personal struggles, and discover confidence in their abilities. Their journey becomes even more challenging when international travel restrictions and political tensions threaten their opportunity to represent Afghanistan in a global robotics competition. From emotional setbacks and difficult sacrifices to inspiring breakthroughs and unforgettable achievements, the girls demonstrate extraordinary courage and determination in the face of adversity. Inspired by true events, the film combines powerful emotional drama, inspiring storytelling, and meaningful messages about education, equality, perseverance, friendship, and the importance of fighting for one’s dreams.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Biography • Inspirational

⭐ IMDb: 6.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: 2h • PG

🎥 Director: Bill Guttentag

source_details.synopsis: Rule Breakers is a 2025 American drama film directed, written, and produced by Bill Guttentag. The film's story follows a visionary woman who sparks hope and opposition, in which their courage ignites a movement that could transform their nation forever. The film premiered at the Linwood Dunn Theater on February 12, 2025, and was released in the United States on March 7, 2025.
